data.name: Laban
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word לָבָן (lāvān) meaning 'white'. In the Bible, Laban is the name of two different characters: 1) Laban the Syrian, a wealthy and cunning man, and 2) Laban the brother of Jacob. Both characters were known for their deceit and their love for material possessions.

in_hebrew.name: לָבָן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לָבָן הוּא שֵׁם הַמְצֻיָּן, שֶׁמְשָׁפֵט צַדִּיק. לְפִיכָך, הוא הַשֵּם הַמִּתְאֲמֵץ בִּפְרָק שֶׁל יוֹעֵץ שֶׁל אָבִיו, בְּרָכְכָה, וְגוֹרָל טוֹב. הַשֵּם הַזֶה, בְּסֵדֶר הַבְּרִית, מֵהַעִבְרִית, שְׁמִיָּה, עֲבָד. הַשֵּם, לָבָן, מְשֻׁלָּב בְּקֶצֶב-פִּסְק, בְּקֶצֶב הַבָּר, וּבְזָמֵן רַב, הוֹאֵל מֶרְחֵב, הוֹאֵל סְבִיב, וְגוֹרָל טוֹב. מֵהַשֵּם, לָבָן, נִמְשָׁךְ, בִּמְעָט, וְכָזָה, בְּאֵיבָה, נִמְשָׁךְ, לָבָן. הַשֵּם, לָבָן, לְאֵין, כָּמוֹ, שְׁמִיָּה, וּבְזֶה, הוּא, כָּמוֹ, שְׁמִיָּה.

in_english.name: Laban
in_english.meaning: white, fair, pure, just, righteous, or white
in_english.long_meaning: The name Laban is derived from the Hebrew root 'lavan', meaning white, fair, or pure. In the Bible, Laban is a prominent figure, representing justice and righteousness. He is a descendant of Abraham and is known for his fairness and generosity. Laban's name is often associated with the concept of righteousness and justice, symbolizing the pursuit of what is fair and good. In Christian tradition, the name Laban is seen as a reminder of the importance of living a life of justice and righteousness, as exemplified by Jesus Christ. The name Laban has also been associated with the idea of purification and cleansing, reflecting the spiritual significance of seeking redemption and forgiveness.

biblical_reference.note: Laban is a prominent figure in the book of Genesis, representing justice and righteousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Laban is of Hebrew origin and is derived from the word 'white'. In ancient times, names had great significance and were often associated with one's character or appearance. For Laban, his name may have reflected his fair complexion or it could indicate his status as a wealthy man. The name Laban is also associated with the biblical character Laban the Syrian, who was known for his cunningness and wealth. This name has been carried through history and is still used as a given name in various cultures.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Laban can be seen as a symbol of material wealth and deceit. In the Bible, both Laban the Syrian and Laban the brother of Jacob were known for their love of material possessions and deceitful behaviors. This name may serve as a reminder to focus on spiritual values rather than material wealth and to resist the temptation to deceive others. The name Laban can also be seen as a call to seek inner purity and to strive for a 'white' or pure heart before God.
